label: Edible Beats brunch menu (Sean's scan)
note: The menu Sean scanned on 2026-08-15 that produced 8 real scores and 21 'We couldn't score this one' fallbacks (EAT-19). Transcribed from the menu photo — this is MENU TRUTH, deliberately not the app's OCR output, which slipped in three places ('Crumpet'→'Cornmeal', 'Masala Potatoes'→'Potato Potatoes', 'Tender Belly Ham'→'Smoked Ham'); those are a separate OCR ticket and must not be baked into the reference. Venue unconfirmed: the menu carries the Edible Beats group logo and 'Chef & Founder / Justin Cucci' but does not name the restaurant. NEEDS A HUMAN PASS: expected tiers below are unset — a model must not write its own answer key.
_whyThisCorpus: 21 of the 29 dishes carry a printed description. That is the point of this corpus and the gap bcd.json cannot cover: EAT-19 only fires on dishes WITH descriptions, so a names-only corpus passes at 100% while two thirds of a real menu comes back unscored. Keep the described/undescribed mix intact when editing.

The eval derives each dish's CATEGORY from these via config/categories.ts rather than being handed it, so the waterfall is under test too. MIMOSAS & MORE is the case that matters: 'BOTTOMLESS CLASSIC ORANGE' contains no word suggesting alcohol and is only a cocktail because of the heading above it.
